App.name: uPdf
App.description: Edit the text in your PDF files.

Home.title: Edit the text in your PDF
Home.description: Add new text or replace existing lines, then download the edited file. Nothing is stored on our servers.

Continue.title: Continue editing {name}
Continue.edits: Saved in this browser · {count, plural, =0 {no edits yet} one {# edit} other {# edits}}

Replace.title: Replace the saved document?
Replace.description: {name} and its edits are saved in this browser. Opening {newName} replaces them.

Errors.not-a-pdf: This file isn't a PDF. Choose a PDF file.
Errors.file-too-large: This file is over 25 MB. Choose a smaller PDF.
Errors.pdf-too-many-pages: This PDF has more than 100 pages. Choose a shorter one.
Errors.pdf-encrypted: This PDF is protected with a password or permissions, so it can't be edited. Save an unprotected copy and try again.
Errors.pdf-unreadable: This PDF is damaged and can't be opened.
Errors.unexpected: Something went wrong while opening the file. Try again.

ExportErrors.invalid-edits: The edits couldn't be applied. Undo the last change and try again.
ExportErrors.unsupported-characters: Some text uses characters its font can't show. Remove them and try again.
ExportErrors.file-too-large: This PDF is over 25 MB, so it can't be downloaded with edits.
ExportErrors.not-a-pdf: This file isn't a PDF, so it can't be downloaded with edits.
ExportErrors.pdf-encrypted: This PDF is protected with a password or permissions, so it can't be edited. Save an unprotected copy and open it instead.
ExportErrors.pdf-too-many-pages: This PDF has more than 100 pages, so it can't be downloaded with edits.
ExportErrors.pdf-unreadable: This PDF is damaged, so the edits can't be saved into it.
ExportErrors.rate-limited: Too many downloads in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
ExportErrors.processing-timeout: Preparing the PDF took too long. Try again.
ExportErrors.unexpected: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.

Editor.noText: No text to replace on this page. Use Add text to write on it.
Editor.replaceHint: Replaced text is hidden, not removed. Don't use this to remove sensitive information.
Editor.textBoxHelp: Enter edits the text. The arrow keys move the box, by more with Shift. Delete removes it.
Editor.autosaveOff: Autosave is off. Download to keep your work.
